text:
marta: Quick async pulse on console observability roadmap — owners, blockers, and short ETA for retention / traces / dashboard updates. TL;DR: retention policy PR needs approval, trace hook tests flaky on staging, dashboards mostly ready but need panel owners and a canary plan. Who can own rollout next week?

sam: I can take dashboards. Which panels specifically?

marta: Panels: model-latency, token-cost, errors-by-route. Preference: sam -> latency + cost, jen -> errors-by-route. Also PRs: retention policy (https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4232) needs review.

jen: I can own errors-by-route. I left comments on the PR about aggregations and time buckets. Fyi dashboards depend on the trace hook landing (ravi has context).

ravi: Trace hook PR landed but tests are flaky — failing on the kv cache path during headless runs. Looking at header propagation and sampling flags. CC @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: Seen elevated 5xx traces during yesterday's small rollout. Not yet tied to trace hook, but sampling config changed yesterday which may skew metrics. Can you confirm sampling flags across envs? :eyes: 

ravi: I reverted the sampling tweak on staging and re-ran the suite. Will post results in ~30m.

marta: Retention discussion: legal/finance requested 90-day logs by default, infra pushed back for cost reasons. Proposal: 60-day traces, 90-day error logs. Need final approval from ops + finance before we flip defaults.

alex: Ops OK with 60/90 split. Need a short SLO impact note before final approval. I wrote a one-pager: https://internal.redwood/docs/obs/retention-60-90 (please review).

sam: Dashboards status: PR opened for panels and layout (https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4251). Assigned @jen for errors panel QA. Also need a perf tweak on the token-cost query — I'll push that today.

jen: Quick question — should error panel show aggregated error fingerprints or raw stack traces? Prefer fingerprints with trace id link for drilling in.

sam: Agreed — fingerprints + trace id link. Keeps panels fast.

ci-bot: build passed for console#4251 — staging deploy queued :rocket:.

marta: Actions / owners recap (short):
- @ravi: finish trace hook fix + mark CI green (target: EOD PST)
- @sam: finalize dashboard rollout plan (canary 10% next Tue) + land perf tweak
- @alex: finalize SLO doc + ops checklist for retention flip
- @jen: land errors panel query update (use fingerprints)

ravi: Fix pushed to branch, running e2e. If green will merge and tag staging. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: If merge happens, set tracing sampling to 0.1 for canary and I'll monitor error rates and paging. Please post the canary tag.

jen: Will land query tweak after CI turns green. ETA tonight.

marta: Thanks all — I'll post a short weekly update to #eng-platform tomorrow AM summarizing owners, dates, and rollback playbook. Ping me in-thread if anything slips. :thumbsup:

sam: +1. Will share canary runbook and dashboard watchlist later today.

marta: Marking this thread resolved for now. Follow-ups in PR threads and the canary runbook doc.
